selection_reasoning: These two tasks form a coherent multi-hop sequence. The player must first locate and mine black_stained_glass (which requires finding it in the scene), and then navigate to find a magenta_wall_banner that is placed behind or beyond the black_stained_glass structure. The dependency is spatial: the black_stained_glass acts as a barrier or window that must be broken/mined to reveal or access the area where the magenta_wall_banner is located. This creates a natural progression where the player must complete the mining task before they can visually discover or physically reach the banner. Both tasks are observable and verifiable - mining produces a block break event, and finding the banner requires proximity/line-of-sight.

milestones.description: Uses count_in_box_at_most(kind='block', object='black_stained_glass', max_count=19) because black stained glass does NOT drop as an item when broken without Silk Touch, making inventory_has impossible. The glass wall at spawn-relative (4,0,9)-(8,3,9) contains exactly 20 blocks (5 wide × 4 tall). Mining at least 1 block reduces the count to ≤19. The check box (3,-1,8)-(9,4,10) generously encloses the wall with ±1 padding. At scene initialization count=20, so 20≤19 is FALSE — milestone is not pre-satisfied.

Uses position_inside_box because the ValidatorAgent confirmed the banner is partially visible THROUGH the black glass from the front room, so position_near_with_facing alone would allow satisfying this milestone without mining the glass. By requiring the player to physically be inside the back room (z≥10, past the glass wall at z=9), we enforce the spatial dependency — the player MUST break through the glass wall to enter the back room where the banner is. The box (3,0,10)-(9,4,12) covers the entire back room section of the building.

scene_description: A stone brick building with a wide open entrance on the south side. Inside, a black stained glass wall divides the room into a front section (accessible from entrance) and a back section. A magenta wall banner hangs on the back wall (north interior wall), hidden behind the dark glass. The player must mine through the black stained glass to physically enter the back room and find the banner. The area around the building is cleared to smooth stone for easy navigation.
task_text: Enter the stone brick building ahead. Inside you will find a black stained glass wall blocking your path. Mine through the black stained glass using your iron pickaxe, then walk into the back room to find and look at the magenta wall banner on the back wall.
design_notes: Building spans ~3,0,5 to ~9,4,12. Entrance: ~4-8, 0-3, z=5 (open south wall). Glass wall: ~4-8, 0-3, z=9 (20 blocks total, 5 wide × 4 tall). Banner: ~6, 2, z=11 (back wall, facing south). Front room: z=6-8. Back room: z=10-11. Player must break glass at z=9 to cross from front room to back room. The position_inside_box milestone (z≥10) ensures the player physically entered the back room, enforcing the dependency on mining the glass first.
